name: Boxx
description: A wizard who uses a box as a stand-in for his body and resurrects Eorra.

description_citations.text: "Distant Planes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Boxx resurrects Eorra, who is too weakened for Gormank to reclaim his honor; Dolores reveals she allowed it to crush him.
timeline.quote: as she had seen into Gormank's soul and knew that the result would crush him.

citation.text: "Distant Planes", section "Festival of Sorrow , by Robert E. Vardeman". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
